name: Universal — Automated Customer Support (All Channels, All Kits)

nodes.name: Support Inbox Webhook
nodes.notes: Central webhook that receives messages from ALL channels: Gmail (via Gmail Watch), Website chatbot, WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, Google Business Profile Q&A, SMS (Twilio). Each channel's n8n node posts here in a normalised format.

nodes.name: Normalise Message Format
nodes.notes: Converts all channel formats (Gmail, WhatsApp, FB Messenger, Chatbot, SMS, GBP) to a single standardised message object

nodes.name: Load Business Knowledge Base
nodes.notes: Loads the business knowledge base built by the Chatbot Installer. Contains: services, prices, policies, FAQs, hours, contact info. Updated automatically when owner edits the sheet.

values.content:
=You are the customer support AI for {{ $env.BUSINESS_NAME }}. Analyse this incoming message and classify it.

BUSINESS KNOWLEDGE BASE:
{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

INCOMING MESSAGE:
Channel: {{ $('normalise-message').item.json.channel }}
From: {{ $('normalise-message').item.json.customer_name }}
Message: {{ $('normalise-message').item.json.message_text }}
Previous context: {{ JSON.stringify($('normalise-message').item.json.previous_messages) }}

Classify this message:

1. tier: 
   - 'tier1_auto': Can be fully resolved using the knowledge base, no human needed
   - 'tier2_assisted': Claude can draft a reply but owner should approve before sending
   - 'tier3_escalate': Requires human handling (legal, refund dispute, media, complex complaint)

2. intent: (pick one)
   - pricing_inquiry | booking_request | service_question | complaint | compliment | emergency | cancellation | refund_request | general_inquiry | legal_threat | media_inquiry | spam | other

3. urgency_score: 1-10 (10 = business-critical, respond within minutes)

4. sentiment: positive | neutral | negative | very_negative

5. can_resolve_with_kb: true/false — is the answer in the knowledge base?

6. if tier1_auto — write the complete reply:
   - resolution_reply: Full reply text, in brand voice, resolves the issue completely
   - action_required: any action to take (book_appointment, send_invoice_link, etc.) or null

7. if tier2_assisted — write a draft:
   - draft_reply: Complete draft for owner to review and send with one tap
   - why_needs_approval: Brief reason

8. if tier3_escalate:
   - escalation_summary: 3-sentence brief of the issue for the owner
   - recommended_action: What the owner should do
   - holding_message: Auto-reply to send while owner is notified

9. owner_whatsapp_preview: 100-char preview of the message for WhatsApp notification

Return as JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — Classify & Route Message
nodes.notes: Core classification node. Claude reads the message against the business knowledge base and routes to the correct tier. Tier 1 = auto-resolve, Tier 2 = draft for owner approval, Tier 3 = escalate immediately.

nodes.name: Prepare Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Packages the auto-reply for sending back through the originating channel

nodes.name: Send Gmail Reply
nodes.notes: Sends reply back via Gmail. Only fires if channel = 'email'.

nodes.name: Send SMS Reply
nodes.notes: Sends reply via Twilio SMS. Only fires if channel = 'sms' or 'whatsapp'.

parameters.message:
=💬 *Draft Reply Ready — Approve to Send*

*From:* {{ $('normalise-message').item.json.customer_name }} ({{ $('normalise-message').item.json.channel }})
*Intent:* {{ $('claude-classify').item.json.intent }}
*Sentiment:* {{ $('claude-classify').item.json.sentiment }}

*Their message:*
_{{ $('normalise-message').item.json.message_text.substring(0, 200) }}..._

*Draft reply:*
{{ $('claude-classify').item.json.draft_reply }}

---
Reply *YES* to send this reply automatically.
Reply *EDIT [your changes]* to modify before sending.
Reply *SKIP* to handle manually.

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Send Draft to Owner
nodes.notes: Sends the Claude-drafted reply to the owner for one-tap approval. Owner replies YES → auto-sends. EDIT [text] → modified reply sent. SKIP → owner handles manually.

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Escalate to Owner
nodes.notes: Immediately alerts owner for Tier 3 issues (legal threats, refund disputes, media). Also sends a holding message to the customer.

nodes.name: Log Ticket to Support Log
nodes.notes: Every message is logged to the support sheet regardless of tier. Enables weekly support digest reporting.

meta.description: UNIVERSAL — ships in every kit. Handles inbound support from ALL channels (Gmail, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, SMS, website chatbot, GBP Q&A) through a single workflow. Claude classifies each message and routes to: Tier 1 (auto-resolves 70%+ of messages), Tier 2 (drafts reply for owner one-tap approval), or Tier 3 (immediately escalates urgent issues). All tickets logged to Google Sheets for weekly digest.
